<div class="section-intro">
Conference contributions are treated as scholarly outputs, but they are presented here rather than duplicated under Publications. Bibliographic identity comes from the canonical research-output catalogue; this section adds verified presentation-level metadata and stable website routes.

{{< include _generated.md >}}

## Catalogue policy

The authoritative scholarly-output source is `qselmer/qselmer/assets/data/publications.json`, synchronized to this website as `assets/data/publications.json`. `talks/registry.json` stores only website-level metadata that ORCID does not reliably provide, such as presentation type, event date, location, presenter, and the stable `/talks/` route.

Legacy `_talks/` files remain temporarily for migration parity and will be removed only after the preserved routes have passed final URL validation.
